invariants.name: event_chain_intact
invariants.description: Every event links to its predecessor and its hash matches its content.

invariants.name: no_commit_without_validation_pass
invariants.description: Every committed state transition names a passing validation of the same proposal.

invariants.name: no_judgment_after_failed_validation
invariants.description: Judgment is only ever consulted after deterministic validation passed.

invariants.name: every_commit_has_provenance
invariants.description: Following causation_id from every commit reaches the proposal event that started it.

invariants.name: no_unsafe_commits
invariants.description: No committed proposal is unsafe according to the independent geometric oracle.

invariants.name: simulated_data_labeled
invariants.description: Only a person's own commands and review decisions may be labeled LIVE, and every human-state datum carries the mode of its event.

invariants.name: zero_network_calls
invariants.description: No judgment request reached a networked provider.
